name: Phase-angle or out-of-step protection
summary: Supervises the angular relationship or loss of synchronism of an electrical system or machine.
description: Supervises the angular relationship or loss of synchronism of an electrical system or machine.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the voltage/current measurement references and protected machine. The associated drawing should trace the out-of-step trip, separation or blocking outputs; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the voltage/current measurement references and protected machine.
Trace the out-of-step trip, separation or blocking outputs.
drawingChecklist: Label the voltage/current measurement references and protected machine.
Cross-reference the out-of-step trip, separation or blocking outputs.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: Out-of-step protection during operation is distinct from a 25 closing-permission synchronism check.
